descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S13 Leave the chart right after tapping Save & Extract, then come back

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Never invent, never drop: a task made from the dictation contains nothing that was not dictated (no added dose, route, frequency or urgency, no supplied decision) and keeps what was dictated, includi … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8; TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Chart with open tasks 'follow up BMP' and 'recheck weight in two weeks' (typed), in each context

When Type 'BMP came back, creatinine 1.1. Advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4.', tap Save & Extract and go straight back to the list; reopen the chart

Then The dictation is still in the encounter box. The closure and the diet task have landed, or an explicit message says they did not

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Judged: the dictated text is kept and shown after coming back (TFA-94229 R9, 'no dictated fact silently disappears'). Recorded, not judged: whether the closure / new task landed or a message was shown (Q9) — saved as evidence files, not as checkpoints, so the oracle cannot score them Pass

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
